title: RMIT-ADM+S at TREC RAG 2026: Research Agents, Retriever Ablations, and Open-Weight Replication
abstract: arXiv:2611.16425v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We describe the RMIT-ADM+S team's participation in the TREC 2026 Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) track using the ClimbMix corpus. We submitted seven research-agent runs using proprietary OpenAI and open-weight models, exploring different retrieval strategies, writer models, and agent workflows. Pre-submission ablations identified writer selection and adjacent-chunk expansion as the main factors affecting answer quality. In the official NIST evaluation, six of seven runs exceeded the track median across all three rubric/nugget collections. Our best-performing run, brief-hybrid, achieved the highest all-item coverage among our submissions and tied the track maximum (0.892) for Batch-1 vital coverage. Human side-by-side preferences differed across evaluation batches: the open-weight owa-glm5 led Batch 1 despite lower automated coverage, while sol-research-first led Batch 2. These findings highlight differences between automated cover

translated_title: RMIT-ADM+S 团队参加 TREC RAG 2026：研究智能体、检索器消融实验与开放权重模型复现
translated_abstract: 我们描述了 RMIT-ADM+S 团队使用 ClimbMix 语料库参加 TREC 2026 检索增强生成（RAG）赛道的情况。我们使用 OpenAI 专有模型和开放权重模型提交了七个研究智能体运行结果，探索了不同的检索策略、写作模型和智能体工作流程。提交前的消融实验发现，写作模型的选择和相邻文本块扩展是影响答案质量的主要因素。在 NIST 官方评估中，七次运行中有六次在全部三个评分标准/要点集合上超过了赛道中位数。我们表现最佳的运行 brief-hybrid 在所有提交中获得了最高的全项覆盖率，并在第一批关键要点覆盖率上打平了赛道最高分（0.892）。人工并排偏好评估在不同评估批次间存在差异：开放权重的 owa-glm5 尽管自动覆盖率较低，却在第一批中领先，而 sol-research-first 在第二批中领先。这些发现凸显了自动覆盖率评估与人工评判之间的差异……
tldr: RMIT-ADM+S 团队在 TREC 2026 RAG 赛道中通过研究智能体与检索器消融实验，七次提交中六次超过赛道中位数，最佳运行 brief-hybrid 打平了第一批关键要点覆盖率的赛道最高分，并证明开放权重模型在人工评估中可与专有模型媲美。
en_tdlr: The RMIT-ADM+S team's research-agent runs at TREC 2026 RAG, with six of seven submissions beating the track median and the best run tying the track maximum for vital coverage, demonstrate that open-weight models can rival proprietary models in human evaluations.
